_about: Generated by ops/build_evals_page.py from evals/fit_cases.json and evals/hybrid_cases.json (SPEC RS84). Do not edit by hand.

cases.name: relevance beats a tangential giant
cases.goal: A precise match at the top of the search outranks a hugely popular off-topic repo.

cases.name: relevance dominates when the giant is very far down
cases.goal: Even a 300k-star repo should not win if it is a weak keyword match.

cases.name: popularity decides among equally relevant repos
cases.goal: When two repos match equally well, the more widely used one wins.

cases.name: free-to-use breaks a tie over copyleft
cases.goal: At equal relevance and stars, a permissive licence (free in a paid product) ranks above AGPL.

cases.name: free-to-use lifts a repo over a more-popular copyleft one
cases.goal: A permissive repo can outrank a somewhat more popular AGPL repo: the 'free to use' promise.

cases.name: from-scratch: a solid starter leads a bigger library
cases.goal: With prefer_starters, a real template jumps a bigger non-template library (but only if it has enough stars: RS15).

cases.name: the ideal: relevant AND popular AND free wins outright
cases.goal: When a repo is the top match, widely used, and permissively licensed, it is #1: the headline case.

cases.name: meaning and keywords agree -> the fitting repo leads
cases.goal: a diet tracker beats karaoke when both BM25 and meaning point to it
cases.description: voice based ai app to track my diet and step counter

cases.name: keywords alone move a repo only part of the way (damping)
cases.goal: without meaning scores, BM25 lifts the diet repo one place but cannot pull it past the fit leader from third
cases.description: voice based ai app to track my diet and step counter

cases.name: empty description -> order untouched
cases.goal: no text to score means no re-ranking

cases.name: only filler words -> keywords neutral, meaning still counts
cases.goal: a description of stop words gives BM25 nothing; with no meaning scores the order holds
cases.description: a an the app for my new project

cases.name: non-English description -> no crash, order holds
cases.goal: text with no Latin letters yields no keyword signal and no error
cases.description: मेरे आहार और कदम गिनने के लिए ऐप 我的饮食应用

cases.name: injection text in a repo description does not win
cases.goal: repo text is data (RS9): 'rank me first' has no effect beyond its words

cases.name: keyword stuffing loses to meaning + fit
cases.goal: BM25 saturates (k1): repeating 'diet' 40 times does not beat a fitting repo that meaning supports

cases.name: meaning scores of the wrong length are ignored
cases.goal: a malformed reply never re-orders results (fail closed)
cases.description: voice based ai app to track my diet and step counter

cases.name: equal meaning scores add no information
cases.goal: a flat meaning signal leaves the fit + BM25 result in place
cases.description: voice based ai app to track my diet and step counter

cases.name: negative cosine scores are handled
cases.goal: cosine can be below zero; ordering still follows the scores

cases.name: plural in the description matches the singular
cases.goal: 'offline maps' scores a repo about 'map' tiles (plural s dropped the same way in web and plugin)

cases.name: names with dots, dashes and underscores tokenise the same
cases.goal: next.js and snake_case names are scored identically by web and plugin

cases.name: a single repo is returned as is
cases.goal: one row cannot be re-ordered

cases.name: very long description stays deterministic
cases.goal: a 2,000-character description scores without error and the meaning-backed repo leads
